title: Bar chart race
description: A ranked bar chart that races through time: values glide between periods, bars overtake each other with a slide, the leader (or the highlighted series) takes the accent, and a huge ghost year counts through the periods. For growth over years, market share shifts and "who leads" stories in explainers.

series.description: "Name=v1, v2, …": one value per period, separated by commas or spaces (no thousands commas: 1240, not 1,240).

periods.description: The period of each value (years count through between periods; other labels step).

top.description: Bars shown at once (the rest wait below and slide in when they climb).

highlight.description: Series in the accent all the way (empty: the accent follows whoever leads).

suffix.description: After every value, e.g. %, k or M.
